
facebookresearch_nevergrad/nevergrad/ops.test_constraint_layer_functionality: test that Constraint layer function returns correct values for positive and negative inputs
facebookresearch_nevergrad/nevergrad/ops.test_constraint_value_bounds: test that constrained parameter args stay below threshold after constraint application

facebookresearch_nevergrad/nevergrad/ops.run_test_constraint_parametrized: run the parametrized test_constraint with num values 1 and 3
